test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: A fruit merchant makes a profit of 25% by selling mangoes at a certain price. If he charges Rs. 3 more on each mango, he will gain 40%. Find the cost price of one mango
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in profit percentages = 40% − 25% = 15%

This 15% of CP corresponds to the increase in selling price, which is Rs. 3.

⇒ 15% of CP = 3

⇒ 1% of CP = 3 ÷ 15 = 0.2

⇒ 100% of CP = 0.2 × 100 = 20

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Profit in case 1 = 25%

Profit in case 2 = 40%

Difference in Selling Prices (SP₂ − SP₁) = Rs. 3

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16b55e837fea47bf9fb764c3a36dae58fab694313833894abda91be9ad9d5694.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the Cost Price (CP) of one mango be Rs. x.

⇒ SP₁ = x × 125 ÷ 100 = 1.25x

⇒ SP₂ = x × 140 ÷ 100 = 1.40x

According to the question,

⇒ SP₂ − SP₁ = 3

⇒ 1.40x − 1.25x = 3

⇒ 0.15x = 3

⇒ x = 3 ÷ 0.15 = 300 ÷ 15

⇒ x = 20

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is always given on the Marked Price (MP) unless specified otherwise. Formula: SP = MP − Discount.

Successive Discount

For two successive discounts of a% and b%, the effective single discount percentage is: a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100.

Dishonest Dealer Concept

When a dealer sells at CP but uses false weight, Profit % = (True Weight − False Weight) ÷ False Weight × 100.
